profile.name: Subham
profile.headline:
Simple design.
Meaningful experiences.
profile.bio:
I’m a student exploring the intersection of modern design and intuitive frontend technology. I craft thoughtful, high-performance digital experiences with clean aesthetics, learning new design systems, and building tools that make everyday interactions delightful.

Welcome to my portfolio! Explore my featured projects, educational journey, and core design toolkit below.

projects.title: Campus Connect
projects.description: A centralized campus community platform designed for students to discover upcoming academic events, collaborate on technical projects, and share educational resources seamlessly.

projects.title: Everyday Studio
projects.description: A clean, minimalist productivity suite that simplifies daily routine tracking through an approachable, gesture-driven user interface and contextual micro-interactions.

projects.title: Personal Playground
projects.description: An interactive digital sandbox showcasing experimental canvas simulations, generative vector geometry, and custom CSS physics animations built during continuous learning.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Design
education.detail: Focusing on Human-Computer Interaction, Modern Web Architecture, and Digital Product Innovation.

experiences.detail: Designed responsive user interfaces in Figma, built reusable React components, and improved application accessibility across mobile and desktop breakpoints.

achievements: Finalist at National Student UI/UX Hackathon 2026
Certified in Advanced Design Systems & Interaction Design
Published open-source component library with 1,000+ downloads
